name: PawPair: Pet Care Tracker
subtitle: Dog & Cat Health Reminders
promotionalText: Keep every dog & cat healthy with 186 custom breed companions, smart daily routines, vet-ready health passports, and 100% private local care tracking.
description:
PawPair is a calm, private home for the everyday care, medication reminders, and health history of every dog and cat you love.

YOUR PET AT THE CENTER — 186 SUPPORTED BREEDS
Create personal companion profiles with custom artwork tailored to your exact dog or cat. From Golden Retrievers and French Bulldogs to Siamese cats and Maine Coons, PawPair celebrates your pet's individuality and keeps them at the heart of your day.

A CALM, EFFORTLESS DAILY RHYTHM
Plan meals, walks, water, medication, grooming, and appointments in an intuitive chronological timeline. See what is next at a glance and mark care moments complete with a single tap.

VET-READY HEALTH PASSPORT
Keep comprehensive, organized medical history right in your pocket. Track weight trends with visual charts, maintain vaccine and preventive care logs, monitor ongoing or resolved symptoms, and log vet notes. Prepare a focused, vet-ready health brief in seconds.

APPLE WATCH CARE ON YOUR WRIST
Glance at today's care progress, see upcoming tasks, and mark doses or walks done or skipped directly from Apple Watch. Offline changes queue safely and synchronize seamlessly when connected.

RELIABLE LOCAL REMINDERS
Never miss an important medication, meal, or vet appointment. Notifications are scheduled locally on your device with comfortable snooze controls and action buttons.

PORTABLE ENCRYPTED BACKUPS
Create password-protected backups that stay entirely in your control. Export, save, or restore through the native system file picker without needing third-party servers.

PAWPAIR PREMIUM
Unlock unlimited companion profiles and seamless caregiver handoff tools. Monthly and annual auto-renewable plans are available. Localized App Store pricing is displayed clearly with zero hidden fees.

100% PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your care data belongs to you. Pet profiles, medical records, and photos stay secure on your device. There are no advertisements, data brokers, or cross-app tracking.

BUILT WITH LOVE FOR IPHONE & APPLE WATCH
Enjoy smooth animations, dark/light adaptive aesthetics, comfortable touch targets, and full accessibility support.

PawPair is designed to assist in daily pet care organization and is not veterinary advice or an emergency service.
